scope: Frozen label/loss equations, actual model/loss/GT-builder code and artificial CPU logits/AST only. No actual source RGB/masks/features/scores/GT targets/weights or current223 files were opened.
not_a_fit_entry_approval: This certifies the reviewed math/code contract, not actual GT/input integrity, completed trainer guards, a fit run, source quality or current evaluation authorization.

labels.A: expected_support_M0 at unchanged nominal9 native coordinates: source isolated-target same-view2D support, not all3D amodal surface or human semantic visibility.
labels.V: visible_target_M4 at those coordinates, valid M4 subset M0. Target ownership is specific to the source instance, not any visible foreground object.
labels.eligibility_A: native continuous in-image AND rounded NN bounds AND cached9 validity intersection; no data-driven new pixel/query selection.
labels.eligibility_visible_given_A: eligibility_A AND GT M0. Outside M0 is a negative only for A and is ignored for the conditional visibility channel.
labels.invalid_unknown: Invalid/unavailable native cells have no auxiliary loss/gradient. Original support U/miss remains zero primary loss, not a covered label. Dense-valid mask labels and primary support U are different notions; current sampled96 queries remain the unchanged admitted known primary cohort.
labels.support_semantics: M0/M4 supervision is auxiliary. Primary reference-local VISIBLE/COVERED teacher, virtual native references, exact query-pixel occupancy and human D/E/S stay separate. M0=0 or M4=0 is never alone semantic E/S.
labels.self: Convex-self1=mayvisible,0=selfhidden,-1unknown remains separate; it is not merged into either dense target.
labels.grid: GT-builder copies frozen V79 nominal9 literal q+(((j+.5)/9)-.5)*L with NN floor+.5 and intersection validity. It is a nominal spatial anchor, not a claim that the P3/RGB receptive field has exact native-pixel support. q/L/r/order are unchanged.

equations.per_query_channel: For eligible cells E_i and binary label t, C_i={c in{0,1}: n_i,c>0}; L_i=(1/|C_i|)*sum_c[(1/n_i,c)*sum_{j in E_i,t_j=c} BCE(z_j,c)]. Empty E_i gives graph-connected zero.
equations.query_reduction: L_A=mean over all96 L_A,i; L_VgivenA=mean over all96 L_VgivenA,i, including zero queries. Do not average only nonempty queries or globally weight all cells.
equations.combined: L_primary + 0.25*(L_A + L_VgivenA)/2. Each auxiliary channel therefore has fixed coefficient0.125; missing one channel/query does not renormalize the other.
equations.gradient: For an admitted cell of class c: dL_aux/dz =0.125/96/|C_i|/n_i,c * (sigmoid(z)-c); outside that eligibility gradient is0.
equations.single_present_class: A query with only one class uses the full class mean, not half a loss. Present-class balancing intentionally makes a small class have equal total weight to the large class within that query.
equations.nonfinite: Implementation rejects nonfinite auxiliary logits rather than silently hiding them behind invalid masks. Empty-zero statements assume finite network outputs.

auxiliary_output_interpretation.channel1: pS=sigmoid(visible_given_M0_logit); not unconditional visible probability and unconstrained by supervision outside true M0.
auxiliary_output_interpretation.derived_source_diagnostics: pVisible=pA*pS; pCovered=pA*(1-pS); pOutside=1-pA. These sum1. They remain source support diagnostics, not human D/E/S or new primary decision scores.
auxiliary_output_interpretation.zero_init: Both auxiliary logits0 imply pA=.5,pS=.5 and jointvisible=.25, not.5. Primary scalar starts according to the unchanged primary initializer and stays separate.
auxiliary_output_interpretation.first_update: With zero aux decoder weight, its first backward can update the decoder but yields zero auxiliary gradient to fused/shared features; later nonzero decoder weights can shape shared features. This is expected, not a skipped supervision bug.

risks_and_falsification: Equal present-class weight can amplify a tiny noisy render/depth boundary class. Keep frozen source boundary/interior diagnostics; no heldout/current-based mask repair or band/lambda sweep.
Shared gradients can trade visible preservation against natural-covered detection. Require the already frozen primary gate and report all groups; auxiliary map improvement alone is insufficient.
If only controlled pairs improve, or C recall improves by violating required V recall, the intended natural-support remedy is not established.
If auxiliary ownership maps include the wrong foreground object, intended-target identity remains unresolved. Same-input auxiliary supervision does not add a category/instance request.
If maps become accurate but scalar support fails, readout/objective coupling is a plausible limit; this is not proof of backbone failure.

Primary selection remains naturalVAL4strata macroBCE; dense metrics/strict535/source gate must not choose checkpoint, threshold or loss weight. Repeated source VAL is development evidence, not fresh deployment proof.
Local BOP historical generation mode/render/delta remains unverified; M0/M4 remain source proxies, not repaired human RGB labels. Virtual references need not lie on mesh surfaces.
final_assessment: No blocker found in this label/reduction/code contract. It is a narrow supervision intervention with unchanged primary inference information; it does not establish target identity or full semantic visibility.
